entities.summary: Qasim, a notable figure in the history of Pakistan, associated with Arab Conquest and Early Muslim Period (711–900). Preceded by Arab Conquest of Sindh. Their legacy influenced Ghaznavid and Ghurid Invasions and Ghurid.
